description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2081/15, Gampaha -D/S Division -  Cad. Map No. 510812  and other amendments
reasoning: This gazette content exclusively deals with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains multiple entries detailing specific corrections to land parcel numbers, extent measurements, village names, cadastral map numbers, and owner names for various land parcels across different districts.
